note: Defaults for Settings. status is 'sourced' only where a real reference has been checked; otherwise 'assumption'. See docs/SOURCES.md.

tariffInrPerKwh.source: Assumption: typical commercial tariff. Replace with the site's tariff.

peakSunHoursPerDay.source: Assumption for southern India. Replace with the local figure.

annualDegradation.source: Assumption: about 0.7 percent per year. To be checked against NREL degradation-rate reviews.

remainingLifeYears.source: Assumption: planned remaining service life of a reused panel.

healthy.source: Assumption: second-hand panel resale, 80 percent or more of rated power.

reduced.source: Assumption: 50 to 80 percent of rated power.

compositionSource: Assumption: approximate composition of crystalline-silicon panels. To be verified against IRENA and IEA-PVPS end-of-life reports.

installAndBosCostInr.source: Assumption: mounting, wiring and labour to put a reused panel into service.

performanceRatio.source: Assumption: system losses between panel and meter.

earlyFailureRiskIfCracked.source: Assumption: share of remaining energy lost if cracked cells progress.

minimumFractionOfRated.source: Assumption: below this the panel is not worth installing.

recycleHandlingCostInr.source: Assumption: collection and transport per panel.
